Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.Peers.Numbe.notes: Native automation-provider composition. Platform-specific Windows notification sequences remain separate validation.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.Peers.Radio.notes: Native automation-provider composition. Platform-specific Windows notification sequences remain separate validation.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.AutoSuggestBo.notes: SuggestionChosen, QuerySubmitted, TextChanged reason and asynchronous filtering require dedicated adapters.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.ContentPresen.notes: Reuse content presentation; WinUI template and alignment semantics require review.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.FontIcon.notes: Native TextBlock font glyph rendering, live typography/foreground and opt-in RTL mirroring. Default Segoe Fluent Icons/20; host must supply licensed font. IsTextScaleFactorEnabled is unsupported; native text-property inheritance differs from some Windows formatting rules.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Frame.notes: Separate opt-in page factory, navigation history, cancellation, failure events, cache and option contracts. Native TypeInfo and typed factory/error adapters replace CLR type activation. Persistent navigation-state serialization and transition parity remain unsupported.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.ListView.notes: Selection modes, containers, item-click behavior and incremental data loading are not implied by this candidate.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.ListViewItem.notes: Container behavior and presentation require explicit tests.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.NavigationVie.notes: DrawerPage provides an existing composition primitive; NavigationView selection, top mode, footer items and hierarchical containers require a new facade.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.NumberBox.notes: Double/NaN numeric domain, parser, validation, native editors/spinners and range automation are implemented as an opt-in facade. NumberFormatter requires the explicit native formatter/parser adapter; Windows globalization and full styling contracts are not certified.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.NumberBoxSpin.notes: Opt-in enum accompanies NumberBox; member-level evidence is tracked separately.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.NumberBoxVali.notes: Opt-in enum accompanies NumberBox; member-level evidence is tracked separately.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Page.notes: Separate opt-in content page with weak Frame ownership, NavigationCacheMode and navigation lifecycle hooks. Existing ContentPage type remains unchanged; Windows-specific inherited contracts remain unverified.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.RadioButtons.notes: Native RadioButton containers and HeaderedSelectingItemsControl support item/header templates, selection, keyboard focus and constrained column-major MaxColumns layout. Native ItemsSource/inline collection rules and invalid-index normalization differ; element factories, template selectors, gamepad escape and exact Windows UIA/theme behavior are not certified.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Symbol.notes: All197 pinned public enum values, XAML enum names and modern rendered glyph conversions. Exact values are checked offline and through native text drawing with deterministic test fonts.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.SymbolIcon.notes: Native icon text rendering with all197 exact pinned public Symbol values mapped through WinUI icon.cpp modern glyph conversion. Default Emoji; licensed font must be supplied by host. Windows visual/font availability parity is not certified.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.TabView.notes: Closing, adding, dragging, tear-out and WinUI tab sizing are additional contracts.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.ToggleSwitch.notes: WinUI XAML IsOn maps to the existing IsChecked property; event contracts and logical behavior still require conformance evidence.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.DataTemplate.notes: Reuse the native template service; WinUI x:Bind and template directives remain separate compatibility work.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.DependencyObject.notes: Reuse the existing object and property system. WinUI dependency-property precedence and callbacks require explicit semantic review.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.FrameworkElement.notes: Layout, resources and inherited data context share the existing framework. WinUI defaults and XAML member spellings remain adapter contracts.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.FrameNaviga.notes: Opt-in native navigation contract; TypeInfo, native page references and typed result/error adapters replace WinRT/CLR handles.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.NavigatingC.notes: Opt-in native navigation contract; TypeInfo, native page references and typed result/error adapters replace WinRT/CLR handles.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.NavigationC.notes: Opt-in native navigation contract; TypeInfo, native page references and typed result/error adapters replace WinRT/CLR handles.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.NavigationE.notes: Opt-in native navigation contract; TypeInfo, native page references and typed result/error adapters replace WinRT/CLR handles.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.NavigationF.notes: Opt-in native navigation contract; TypeInfo, native page references and typed result/error adapters replace WinRT/CLR handles.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.NavigationM.notes: Opt-in native navigation contract; TypeInfo, native page references and typed result/error adapters replace WinRT/CLR handles.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.PageStackEn.notes: Opt-in native navigation contract; TypeInfo, native page references and typed result/error adapters replace WinRT/CLR handles.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.StaticResource.notes: Reuse the native static-resource markup extension; cross-dictionary lookup and missing-key behavior require conformance evidence.

Microsoft.UI.Xaml.UIElement.notes: Reuse routing, focus and pointer ownership. The inheritance trees and event argument shapes differ.

markup:Binding.notes: Missing Mode becomes explicit OneWay. Existing binding engine handles the resulting markup; Mode=Default requires explicit review.

markup:ThemeResource.notes: Explicit for_winui_theme policy maps to live DynamicResource lookup. Ported dictionaries and theme scopes must be supplied; this is not proof of all WinUI theme semantics.

markup:x:Bind.notes: Typed root/named-element sources, OneTime default, function expressions and generated lifecycle require a dedicated implementation. Migration emits a diagnostic rather than substituting Binding.

x:Class.notes: Application namespace mappings rewrite class identity explicitly. C# code-behind still requires a Rust port.

x:DataType.notes: Type references follow explicit alias mappings; this does not implement x:Bind expression semantics.

x:Load.notes: Deferred creation and named-element lifetime require implementation; the migration pass reports the directive.

x:Name.notes: Namescope spelling is preserved; named field/code-behind creation remains owned by the normal XAML compiler.

x:Phase.notes: Phased rendering lifecycle is not implemented by renaming this directive.
